hunks.baseline: Cough.
Jang Il stared blankly at the sword buried in his chest, then coughed up blood.
hunks.sol: Jang Il stared blankly at the sword buried in his chest and coughed up blood.

hunks.baseline: Why? How?
hunks.sol: Why?
What for?

hunks.baseline: The questions never made it out of his mouth. His knees buckled as he looked at the military official through hazy eyes.
hunks.sol: The questions never escaped his lips. His knees buckled as he stared at the officer through clouding eyes.

hunks.baseline: His face slammed into the new shoots just beginning to rise from the earth. A cold voice reached his ears.
hunks.sol: His face struck the new shoots just beginning to emerge from the earth, and a cold voice reached his ears.

hunks.baseline: “What a stupid beggar bastard. Why did he have to be here of all places…?”
hunks.sol: “Stupid beggar bastard. Why did he have to be here of all places…?”
